insights.summary: Q1 FY27 was HFCL's best quarter: revenue up 120% to ₹1,915 Cr, reported EBITDA of ₹445 Cr (23.25%) and PAT of ₹246 Cr, with exports of ₹1,063 Cr. The MD raised FY27 revenue growth to 40%+ (from ~20%) and called 23% the minimum EBITDA margin he can protect. The order book reached ₹26,665 Cr; data-centre connectivity should bring ~₹800 Cr this year as capacity grows 5x, and defence and aerospace should cross ₹3,000 Cr by FY29.

what_changed.text: FY27 revenue growth raised to 40%+ from about 20%
EBITDA margin: 23% now the floor, vs 20% expected in May
Data-centre connectivity revenue ~₹800 Cr in FY27 (was ₹400 Cr)
₹215 Cr for MMC/SNMT data-centre connectivity capacity
Defence and aerospace target ₹3,000 Cr+ by FY29, ₹5,000 Cr after

tone.label: confident
tone.quote: Look, I will give you a 5-year outlook. Why 3 years? 3 years is a no-brainer.

analyst_questions.answer: Prefers to under-promise; Q1 annualised is higher.
No seasonality; Q1 margin came from average contracts and should hold all year.
Some long-term contracts run into next year; increases offset by customer prices and value-added products.
Roughly ₹1,900 Cr a quarter, give or take 10%.

red_flags.text: Defence restructuring moves businesses into a subsidiary where HFCL may hold about 51%.
Preform contracts will reset at higher prices; margin defence relies on customer price rises.
Big capex step-up (₹640 Cr and ₹615 Cr) while working capital also rises.
EPC losses only 'significantly come down', not gone, after the Army AMC.

watch_next: Army AMC signing and EPC losses
